title: Wait Time Canada - Health Systems Observatory for Emergency Department Wait Times
description: A clinically defensible public-interest Health Systems Observatory for Canadian emergency department wait-time methodology and data quality. The project audits and exposes methodological inconsistencies in ER reporting across provinces (ON, QC, AB, BC), provides access to current public hospital reporting, and publishes methodology-aware analytics, public health resources, and transparent limitations.
notes: Wait Time Canada is operated as a public-interest health data and methods observatory with an emphasis on methodology transparency, equity-aware access, stewardship, and responsible reuse of official public data.
